Update file paths when porting across repo extractions

entries.approach: Changed remove_from_cross_doc_indexes from O(total indexed) to O(doc size) by looking up the existing DocumentIndex for the URI and iterating only its slugs/block_ids/tags to target specific cross-doc map entries, instead of scanning all buckets.

Guard early-return for first-time add (no existing doc to clean) vs replacement (existing doc needs cleanup)
Collect keys into Vec before mutating maps to avoid borrow conflicts

entries.approach: DeepWiki for tree-sitter grammar exploration: asked deepwiki about tree-sitter-yaml CST node structure to unblock parser implementation. Revealed key insight: values wrapped in flow_node/block_node/plain_scalar layers, and document child is block_node not block_mapping directly.
entries.outcome: Unblocked after CST structure clarified. 25 tests GREEN in one iteration.

entries.approach: tree-sitter has_error() is O(1) vs manual recursive has_error_nodes() which is O(n). Use root.has_error() for malformed syntax detection.
entries.outcome: 10,000-key YAML parsing dropped from >10s to <7s debug / <3s release

entries.approach: JSON5 parser: two-phase design — json5 crate (serde) for structure validation + custom Scanner for byte-accurate source positions. Scanner drives iteration in source order and looks up keys in serde map. Handles unquoted identifiers, single-quoted strings, comments, trailing commas, escaped characters.
entries.outcome: 16 integration + 7 unit tests. Byte-accurate positions verified. serde_json::Map key ordering solved via source-order scanning.

entries.approach: Batch PR review triage: categorized 8 comments by severity (1 critical, 2 major, 5 minor). TDD for all fixes — wrote 6 failing tests first, then implemented fixes. Combined DRY refactor (byte_to_position extraction) with bugfixes in single commit. All pre-commit hooks passed on second attempt (cargo fmt diff).
patterns: When scanner and serde parse the same input, scanner must reproduce serde's decoding for key lookup
DRY extraction during review fixes is efficient — touch the files once for both
Move Position import to test modules when only tests use it (avoids unused import warnings)
Run cargo fmt before commit when touching many files — pre-commit hook catches formatting diffs

entries.approach: Miri arena validation: wrote 14 tests in markymark-core (no FFI deps) replicating production unsafe patterns. FakeAst/FakeIndex/FakeProperties mirror Ast/DocumentIndex/parser types. Discovered Box aliasing issue (6 tests) and mem::forget heap leak (3 tests). Key insight: Vec<&'static str> passes Miri but &'static [T] as struct field fails — Vec's drop doesn't access arena memory, but slice references create protected tags during drop.
patterns: Test unsafe patterns in FFI-free crate (markymark-core) since Miri can't run C FFI (tree-sitter)
Vec<&'static str> + Box<Arena> is Miri-safe; &'static [T] + Box<Arena> triggers Box aliasing violation
Use -Zmiri-ignore-leaks when mem::forget is intentional in the pattern being tested
Separate Miri cache key in CI to avoid polluting stable build cache

entries.approach: Benchmark-driven investigation: wrote targeted arena lifecycle benchmarks (create+alloc+drop vs reset+alloc) alongside full reparse benchmarks. Quantified exact overhead ratio before making build/no-build decision. Saved days of wasted implementation effort.
patterns: Always benchmark before optimizing — arena reuse looked promising but was <0.1% of total cost
Compare micro-optimization to full pipeline cost to determine if it's worth pursuing
Closing a task with 'won't implement' + evidence is a valid and valuable outcome

entries.approach: Minimal structural refactor: Option-wrapped md_tree in Ast with take_md_tree(), re-export MarkdownTree from parser crate, HashMap in ServerState. Zero changes to DocumentIndex or from_ast — verified from_ast never touches md_tree before proceeding.
patterns: Verify downstream consumers don't use the field before taking it — grep from_ast for md_tree usage
Re-export types from the crate that owns them to avoid transitive dependency pollution
Option wrapping enables take() semantics without changing struct layout significantly
